description_en: Tāpā Hiti Phalcā West is located in a compound comprising of otherphalcā,asatah, a temple and two stepwells after which the area is named. Two historic stone fountains make up the centre of the compound. A stone inscription recording the initial construction of the Phalcā has been lost. According to local residents Tāpā Hiti Phalcā West was commissioned by a local resident from the Śreṣṭha caste by the name of Subbā. Subbā was a governor or chief administrative officer of a province or district in the Raṇā period. This is why Tāpā Hiti Phalcā West is also known as Subbā Phalcā.The Phalcā suffered severe damage in the 2015 earthquakes when the tree in front of the Gaṇeśa Mandira (LAL0840) fell on its roof. A co-financing solution was found in order to restore the building: In 2017, Lalitpur Metropolitan City provided 12 lākh rupees, the descendants of the founder donated some funds and locals contributed by running charity works. Together, these groups raised enough money to reconstruct the Phalcā. The reconstruction work was completed in early 2020 but as of summer 2020 the building has not  been formally inaugurated. Statues of Nārāyaṇa and Umāmaheśhwara used to be housed in two niches, unfortunately both niches remain empty after the theft of the statues.Subba's descendants distributesamaybajiannually in the Phalcā on the day of Indrajātrā (13thday of the bright fortnight of Bhādra).
description_ne: तापा हिति टोलमा दुईवटा ढुंगेधाराहरू छन् । तीमध्ये पानी आउन बन्द भइसकेको ढुंगेधाराको उत्तरमा यो फल्चा रहेको छ । यो फल्चा तापा हिति टोलका श्रेष्ठहरूद्वारा बनाइएको हो । फल्चा निर्माणसम्बन्धी शिलापत्र हराइसकेकाले यसको निर्माण गर्ने व्यक्तिको नाम र तिथिमिति थाहा हुन सकेन । स्थानीयहरू फल्चा निर्माण गर्ने श्रेष्ठहरूको परिवारलाई सुब्बा भनी सम्बोधन गर्छन् । सरकारी सेवामा सुब्बाको काम गर्ने श्रेष्ठले बनाएको फल्चा हुनाले यस फल्चालाई सुब्बा फल्चा पनि भनिन्छ ।प्रत्येक वर्ष भाद्र शुक्ल १३ इन्द्रजात्राको दिनमा सुब्बाको परिवारले यस फल्चामा बसेर समयबजि वितरण गर्दै आइरहेको छ । फल्चामा दुईवटा खाली प्रतिमास्थानहरू रहेका छन् जसमा पहिले नारायण र उमामहेश्वरका मूर्तिहरू राखिएका थिए । ती मूर्तिहरू चोरी भएपछि दुइटै गवाक्षहरू खाली नै छन् । फल्चा पुरानो भएर मर्मत गर्नुपर्ने अवस्थामा पुगिसकेको थियो, त्यसमाथि २०७२ को भूकम्पले यसमा झन् क्षति पुर्यायो । पछि तापा हितिको थान गणेश (LAL0840) अगाडि रहेको वरपीपलको रूख ढलेर यस फल्चाको छानामा पर्नाले यसको छाना भत्केको थियो । विसं २०७४ मा ललितपुर महानगरपालिकाबाट प्राप्त १२ लाख रकम, फल्चा-निर्माता सुब्बाको परिवारबाट प्राप्त केही रकम र नपुग स्थानीयहरूको श्रमदानबाट फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको गरिएको छ । पुनर्निर्माणको काम सम्पन्न भइसके पनि यसको विधिवत् उद्घाटन भने भइसकेको छैन ।

historical_events.event_description: Funds were raised for the reconstruction of the building in 2017. The Lalitpur Metropolitan City provided 12lākhrupees (ca. 9,000 Euros), the descendants of the founder donated some additional money and locals contributed through charity works. The reconstruction work was completed in early 2020, but as of summer 2020 the formal inauguration had taken place.
The phalcā was already in need of repair before it was further damaged in the 2015 earthquakes. A tree in front of the Gaṇeśa Mandira (LAL0840) fell on the building  and damaged its roof.
